overview: Before adding more tracking, find out what you already have. We walk through your site with a browser inspector and your analytics and ad accounts, list every tag, pixel and event that fires, and test whether each reports correctly. The result is a clear sheet marked working, broken, duplicated or missing, with a fix for each and the order to do them in.

faq: What do I get at the end?
A spreadsheet of everything that fires on your site, with a status for each, screenshots as proof and a ranked list of fixes. Premium adds the changes themselves and a retest.
Will you change anything in my accounts during the audit?
No, not in Basic or Standard. We only look and test. In Premium we make the fixes you approve and log each one, so changes can be reversed if needed.
Is the audit useful for a site that is brand new?
Yes, it can stop mistakes before they feed bad data into months of reports. For a new site we also check that the basics are installed in the right place.
How is this different from Data Cleanup?
The audit finds and ranks problems. Data Cleanup repairs deeper issues in reports and history. Many people start with the audit, then pick the fixes that matter to them.
